papers.topic: LinearLayout — GF(2)/F2 linear maps as the universal layout algebra (Triton v3 layout system)
papers.verified: web-verified (PROMOTED from unverified-candidate — formal paper found this pass; the recon predated its publication)
papers.evidence: Header derives the model: a layout is a linear map over GF(2), fixed by its values on power-of-2 basis inputs; composition/inversion/quotient are RREF over GF(2). Abstract of 2505.23819: 'models tensor layouts using linear algebra over F_2 ... binary matrices acting on the bits of the hardware representation', integrated with Triton — matches the source exactly. Its own chapter, paired with the Four Russians box for the RREF engine.
papers.fetch_note: WebFetch arxiv.org/abs/2505.23819 成功(复用 ch20 已抓,本 pass 再核一次)。标题《Linear Layouts: Robust Code Generation of Efficient Tensor Computation Using F_2》,作者 Keren Zhou, Mario Lezcano, Adam Goucher, Akhmed Rakhmati, Jeff Niu, Justin Lebar, Pawel Szczerbuk, Peter Bell, Phil Tillet, Thomas Raoux, Zahi Moudallal(11 人)。摘要逐字确认『models tensor layouts using linear algebra over F_2』『binary matrices acting on the bits of the hardware representation』『generic layout-to-layout conversions, eliminating the quadratic explosion』『integrate linear layouts with Triton』。B 档:仅作学术出处。ch23 的 GF(2) 技术展开以更强的 A 档源码注释为第一依据:LinearLayout.h:31-74(key fact + 4x4 swizzle + xor 线性律 L(a⊕b)=L(a)⊕L(b) 逐字)、:183-277(GF(2) 加=xor/乘=and、bases=2 幂次点取值)、LinearLayout.cpp:65-113(getMatrix 布局→比特矩阵)、:843-922(invertAndCompose 拼接+RREF)、:151/:912(f2reduce::inplace_rref_strided 两处调用)。

papers.topic: Four Russians / f2reduce — GF(2) Gaussian elimination (RREF) engine under LinearLayout
papers.verified: web-verified (Four Russians origin, Wikipedia) + source-cited (f2reduce README in-repo)
papers.evidence: README names the algorithm outright; LinearLayout composes/inverts by row-reducing a bit-packed boolean matrix. A 3-5 sentence box inside the LinearLayout primer ('layouts compose/invert by RREF over GF(2); f2reduce does it fast via the Four Russians block-lookup trick') demystifies the call without a separate chapter.
papers.fetch_note: A 档实锤:third_party/f2reduce/README.md 在仓库内,:1 逐字『a MIT-licenced library for Gaussian elimination over GF(2)』、:5 『converting a binary matrix to row reduced echelon form』、:7 逐字点名『Kronrod's algorithm ('method of four Russians')』;:17-25 自陈不用 Strassen、大满秩会被 M4RI 反超但小/宽/低秩更快(LL 比特矩阵 ≤64 列正好命中强项)。f2reduce.h:7-24 给 inplace_rref_strided 签名 + little-endian 位打包语义。LinearLayout.cpp:151(求秩)、:912(求逆复合)两处调用。无独立在线 README URL,直接用仓库内 README 逐字(比在线更权威)。

papers.topic: Method of Four Russians — origin & complexity (background for f2reduce speed)
papers.evidence: Background for why f2reduce is fast enough to run the unified layout algebra at compile time: block-lookup trick shaves a log factor off GF(2) Gaussian elimination. One background box, C-doc only.
papers.fetch_note: WebFetch en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Method_of_Four_Russians 成功。核实:由苏联学者 Vladimir Arlazarov、Yefim Dinitz、Mikhail Kronrod、Igor Faradzhev 于 1970 年提出;技术=把矩阵切 t×t 小块 + 预建查表替代逐格运算,加速涉及布尔矩阵(或每格取值有限)的算法;取 t=log n 时查表构建 O(n(log n)^2)、处理 O(n^2/(log n)^2),整体较标准消元削一至两个对数因子(GF(2) 高斯消元约 O(n^3)→O(n^3/log n));M4RI 库实现其 F_2 变体(SageMath/PolyBoRi 用)。C 档,仅作 §6 背景盒。
